claims: Match Day 2026 took place on Friday, March 20, 2026.
Thousands of medical students nationwide discovered their residency placements on March 20, 2026.
The National Resident Matching Program (NRMP) held the main event at 12:00 p.m. ET on March 20, 2026.
The 2026 Main Residency Match is the largest in history.
More than 93% of residency positions were filled nationwide.
LSU Health Shreveport held celebrations on March 20, 2026.
University of Florida held celebrations on March 20, 2026.
UC Davis held celebrations on March 20, 2026.
On March 16, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. ET, applicants learned if they matched.
The SOAP process took place Monday through Thursday of Match Week 2026.
On March 20, 2026, at 12:00 p.m. ET, Match Day results were released.
Match Day results revealed where applicants matched.
